altnames.hhbib_lgcode: Guyanese (or Guyanan or Guyana) Sign Language (GSL)

classification.sub: Guyana Sign Language and American Sign Language are discussed as two different entities in **hh:soc:ParksWilliams:Deaf-Americas(**):29-30 but at the same time it is implied that Guyana Sign Language is a recent American Sign Language offshoot. A check of the dictionary (**hh:d:CabbagePeterson:Guyana-Sign**) is urgently needed. In the meantime, Guyana Sign Language is at least implied to be related to American Sign Language.
